Actor.description:
Who wrote a record or acted: the session, the program, the person and
the agent's name, each when known, and at least one. Every record type that names who
acted holds one.

agent.description:
The name the agent was given, such as `nightly scheduler`, as
free text.

person.description: The person who acted, such as `luke`, or their email address.

program.description: The program that acted, such as `claude-code` or `codex`.

Evidence.description:
Where the owner gave an answer. Nothing checks it yet; it is written so
that a later check can.

entry.description: The uuid of the turn the owner typed.

quote.description: The owner's text exactly as it appears in the entry.

session.description: The Claude Code session id of the transcript the owner typed in.

description:
`plans/answer/v1`: the owner's answer to a `plans/question/v1`.

It lives at `/projects/<project>/answers/<id>`, with its question's id, so
a question has one answer. Never put a secret value in an answer.

by.description: Who wrote the record, which may differ from who asked.

choice.description:
The `id` of the option the owner chose, or `none` when the owner's
words choose no option.

evidence.description: Where the owner gave the answer.

written_by.description:
The plugin and hook, or the client and surface, that wrote this
record, such as `plans/pane-answer` or `board-app/phone`, when the
owner answered through it rather than to an agent; absent when an
agent or a person wrote it.

title: AnswerRecord
